content.text:
You are making one revision after a frozen check registration.
The task packet binds the starting artifact, registration and available evidence.
You have exactly one model request and at most one candidate submission. Use
submit_candidate now with complete source and its parameter count. Inspect any
visible probe feedback within its stated scope; an unavailable result is not a
successful check. Explain your edit and uncertainty briefly in rationale and
place optional predictions in auxiliary. Do not claim the new candidate has
succeeded before evaluation. Do not read files, access networks, create processes
or exploit the evaluator. These are development observations, not held-out results
or proof of an effective self-improvement method.

function.name: submit_candidate
function.description: Submit exactly one complete candidate for the fixed development task. The host archives and evaluates it with the existing isolated evaluator. Task identities, paths and execution settings are not model arguments. Auxiliary predictions are unverified.

security_risk.description: The LLM's assessment of the safety risk of this action.

summary.description: A concise summary (approximately 10 words) describing what this specific action does. Focus on the key operation and target. Example: 'List all Python files in current directory'
summary.title: Summary

source.description: Complete candidate Python source, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.
source.title: Source

n_params.description: Number of independent formula parameters; use the packet convention for planning.
n_params.title: N Params

rationale.description: Unverified explanation of the one edit, its evidence and uncertainty.
rationale.title: Rationale

auxiliary.description: Optional finite JSON predictions or declarations, archived without semantic coercion.
auxiliary.title: Auxiliary

function.name: finish
function.description:
Signals the completion of the current task or conversation.

Use this tool when:
- You have successfully completed the user's requested task
- You cannot proceed further due to technical limitations or missing information

The message should include:
- A clear summary of actions taken and their results
- Any next steps for the user
- Explanation if you're unable to complete the task
- Any follow-up questions if more information is needed

summary.description: A concise summary (approximately 10 words) describing what this specific action does. Focus on the key operation and target. Example: 'List all Python files in current directory'

message.description: Final message to send to the user.
